description.en: A divided fossil frond carries thick, entire-margined rounded pinnules.
description.zh: 分裂化石叶带厚实、全缘、圆钝小羽片。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Pachypteris, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Pachypteris 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Broad solid pinnules on divided rachises differ from thin incised fern blades and the existing cycad's narrow rigid leaflets.
distinctness.zh: 分枝叶轴上的宽厚实小羽片区别于薄深裂蕨叶及现有苏铁窄硬小叶。

modeling_brief.en: Give the pinnules shallow volume and rounded polygonal tips; preserve frond branching rather than inventing a shrub.
modeling_brief.zh: 赋予小羽片浅体积和圆钝多边形尖端，保留叶轴分枝，不臆造灌木。

uncertainty: No full plant or mangrove ecology is asserted from detached foliage.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
